observing.naked_eye: Not normally visible as a distinct nebula to the unaided eye.
observing.binoculars: Look for a low-contrast patch against the surrounding field; dark adaptation matters more than high magnification. The field lies within the Almanack's visible Milky Way boundary, so the background is especially star-rich.
observing.telescope: Use low to moderate power to trace the nebular form; a suitable narrowband nebula filter can improve contrast on emission-rich regions.
